rules.title: ES modules
rules.text: Use ES modules and the node: prefix for built-in imports.

rules.title: async/await
rules.text: Use async/await and always handle promise rejections.

rules.title: Central config
rules.text: Read environment variables in one config module and validate them at startup.

rules.title: Graceful shutdown
rules.text: Handle SIGTERM and close servers and connections gracefully.

rules.title: No blocking calls
rules.text: Do not use synchronous filesystem or crypto calls in request handlers.

rules.title: Use streams for large data
rules.text: Use streams for large files instead of loading them into memory.

rules.title: Handle unhandled rejections
rules.text: Treat unhandled rejections and uncaught exceptions as fatal and exit so the supervisor restarts the process.

rules.title: Keep the event loop free
rules.text: Move CPU-heavy work to worker threads or separate services.

rules.title: Use --env-file
rules.text: Load local env with --env-file or the platform; do not commit .env.

rules.title: node: prefix
rules.text: Import Node.js built-in modules with the node: prefix.
